families.constraints: Use original real domains, signed bounds and source-given versus worked diagrams. A proper interval cannot cross a pole. families.difficulty_progression: YM16 has one valid positive count;Try16Q2 has1and17;Try16Q3 has a second positive but noninteger candidate. Example19 combines counts of signed terms.
families.distinction_basis: Cumulative sums and integer selection differ from a term-value threshold.
